name: focus-book-{DAY}
title: Focus book {DAY}
subtitle: The highest-margin trades for the next two weeks and the month: every name with a buy band, a kill on a close, a target and its up / risk, the Book's lines, the AI lane kept apart, shorts, and what outside context the data confirms. Lanes are filters on the opportunity board; each column is one read and nothing is a sum.

entries.group: Letters (det: deterioration; pat_up / pat_dn: winners anatomy)
rows: E
det: next-FY EPS estimate cut by more than 1% over about 3 months. pat_up: not used.
R
det: next-FY revenue estimate cut by more than 1% over about 3 months.
C
det: free cash flow margin under 0 (cash burn). pat_up: street upside in its top quintile, a print within 28 days, estimates not cut, under the 200-day.
S
det: last reported EPS under its estimate.
O
pat_up: RSI in its lowest quintile with p_fwd in its top quintile (oversold, forward set-up strong).
B
pat_up: printed within 10 days with a beat, last week in its lowest quintile (a beat that was sold).
I
pat_up: the industry's 3-month return in its lowest quintile while the industry's last surprises are in their top quintile.
D
pat_up: 1-month return in its lowest quintile with p_dvc in its top quintile (a durable compounder that fell).
H
pat_up: far from its 91-day high (hi_prox lowest quintile) with p_dvc in its top quintile.
V
pat_up: 3-month return in its lowest quintile, street upside in its top quintile, estimates not cut.
L
pat_up: 1-month return in its lowest quintile, street upside in its top quintile, a print within 28 days.
X
pat_dn: breakout score in its top quintile with weekly consensus in its lowest (a breakout nobody confirms).
Y
pat_dn: breakout score in its top quintile with p_fwd in its lowest quintile.
Z
pat_dn: 1-month return in its top quintile with p_fwd in its lowest quintile (a run without a forward read).
Lane
Why the row is in the focus book: unpriced value, low-beta large cap, post-print (beat sold / re-entry), pre-print, event build-up, Book add, AI lane, deep-discount lane, short.
Value
The line's market value in USD at the pack's close.
P&L
The line's unrealized gain or loss in USD against its cost.
Bar / odds
What the print's measured cells say: the set-up cell's mean, the big-move odds (u10_hi) and the hold-through counts (h28 up / down pointers).
Question
The question the MU table answers from the pack.
Data
The pack's numbers for that question (cycle scenarios, deterioration cell, recovery clock, event risk), or an OUTSIDE fact tagged as such.
Move / fact
An outside market fact (OUTSIDE, dated and sourced), not measured into any column.
Checked in data
What the pack shows for the same thing, or why it cannot be checked (not in the scans).
Item
The outside event or reading (OUTSIDE): timing and grade only, never a sort key or a size.
Signal
A measured market or name reading used to judge whether the selloff has bottomed (sentiment pattern, crash follow-through, drawdown episode, deterioration cell).
Now
The reading's value on this pack (live today or not, the level, the count).
Measured
What the store says followed that reading: lift vs every day / excess vs the market over the next sessions, hit rate and n. Direction, not proof.
Read
The judgment: what the reading changes in timing or size (never a sort key).
z
The crash step's move in standard deviations of that industry's own 5-step moves (negative = crash).
hit_pct
Share of crash steps after which the industry beat the market over that many steps, %.
fam
The families the row passes, one lowercase letter each; a tier is an intersection of letters, never a sum.
w
Bounce: washed out, at least 13% under the 52-week high (to_hi52_pct 15+) with RSI 50 or under or the month down 5%+.
f
Bounce: business intact, no deterioration letter, next-FY EPS estimate not cut over 3 months, FCF margin above 0, net debt / EBITDA under 3.
m
Bounce: margin of safety, cheaper than peers with the same profile (peer_gap_pct above 0) and the forward-value base or the street at least 15% over the close.
s
Bounce: the drawdown state paid, the deterioration count cell beat the median over 28 days on the store (cnt_fx_28d_mean above 0).
b
Band in reach: the bounce band top within 6% under the close (bounce tier) or 8% (up-slope).
u
Up-slope: above the 50-day and the 200-day, 3 months up, rsi under 70.
g
Up-slope: growth, revenue up 10%+ year on year or next-FY EPS growth 15%+.
q
Up-slope: quality, FCF margin 10%+ and operating margin 15%+.
p
Up-slope: next-FY EPS estimate raised 3%+ over 3 months.
tier
Bounce: A = w f m s b, B = w f b plus m or s. Up-slope: A = g q p, B = g or q with p, C = the lane's floor only.
Families
The fam letters of the pick (see above).
Hold
The planned holding period: days for an AI bounce, weeks to a month outside it.
Media check
The media protocol's read on the name (OUTSIDE): confirm, neutral or contra; contra delays the entry, never sizes it.
Tone
The media read: confirm, neutral or contra (OUTSIDE).
What the media says
The dated outside headline or read, in brief (OUTSIDE).
Effect
What the read changes: timing or grade only.
Short band
Short entry: the price zone, or the close that triggers the short (a failed bounce).
Stop (close)
Short stop: a close above this price covers the short.
Cover
Short target: where the short is covered.

description: Operator page template. Lanes come from {PACK}/analysis_scans (focus scans on the board, recorded in the judgment scans); judgment from logs/canvases/{DAY}/judgment.json pages.focus_book. Render: tv_scan_cli.py page --template focus_book --day YYYYMMDD --judgment J --out-dir RUN_DIR --strict.
